note: Day 4 first harvest (work pack 02-B). Pull six qingling herbs from TY_Field01, sort them onto three bundles, sell at Market_HerbalStall. Light and short, never a loss: no haggling, nothing thrown away, the lowest grade still pays. Pure rules in tools/harvest-market/rules.ts; HarvestMarketSim.cs mirrors them for Unity.

looks.look.top: 葉子完整，葉尖微微發光

sortBonus.note: A sold bundle whose every plant really is the bundle grade earns this much more. A reward for careful sorting, never a penalty: mixed bundles still pay by real grade.

lines.text: 這捆裡混了一株次一等的，我照實際的算給你。
這捆裡藏了一株好的，照實算，不讓你吃虧。
今天坊市正缺青靈草，每捆多給一點。
都留著也好，煉丹、泡茶都用得上。
